title: Tracked secret-like value
recommendation: Rotate the value if real, remove it from git history, and keep environment files untracked or in a secret manager.

title: Cross-tenant BOLA/IDOR across business APIs
recommendation: Derive company context server-side and enforce membership/object ownership on every read and mutation.

title: API auth guard fails open when InsForge is misconfigured
recommendation: Fail closed in production and only enable mock users through an explicit local development flag.

title: Dashboard hard-codes shared test tenant
recommendation: Fetch tenant context from authenticated server-side identity instead of hard-coded client values.

title: Database failure falls back to sample data
recommendation: Return controlled errors for production data endpoints; keep sample fallbacks local-only.

title: Public AI chat endpoint needs stronger abuse controls
recommendation: Add per-route quotas, request limits, upstream timeouts, and abuse monitoring.

title: Public lead capture stores PII in plain local JSON
recommendation: Add length/spam controls and move PII to an access-controlled store with retention policy.

title: Missing CSP and HSTS headers
recommendation: Add a tested Content-Security-Policy and HTTPS-only Strict-Transport-Security in production.

title: Dependency audit has moderate vulnerabilities
recommendation: Upgrade postcss and review the drizzle-kit/esbuild transitive chain for safe remediation.

title: Docker base image is not digest-pinned
recommendation: Pin node:22-alpine by digest and update on a controlled cadence.

title: Public checkout diagnostic endpoint exposes config state
recommendation: Remove or restrict the diagnostic endpoint.

title: Embedded openensemble directory has many Semgrep findings
recommendation: Confirm whether it ships with EcoAuditor; remove, isolate, or audit separately.
